name: Temper
overview: Scripture warns against a quick temper, highlighting that hastiness in anger leads to foolishness and strife, while patience and self-control are marks of wisdom and strength. The Psalms encourage believers to cease from anger and avoid wrath to prevent doing evil, and Proverbs teaches that a gentle response can defuse anger, whereas harsh words escalate it. The Bible values those who govern their spirit and are slow to anger, depicting them as mightier than conquerors, and contrasts the impulsive fool who speaks rashly with the wise who restrain their words.
